answer: One enforceable rule: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The network ties the ferrous to sunk effort, uses the timber as an corroborating signal, then requires a delta before any payout.
